title: One by One
body: Your weekly missionary coordination meeting. Help each person take their next step on the covenant path. Here’s how to use Huddle each week.

title: Four steps each week
body:
1. Before Ward Council
2. Ward Council
3. The Huddle
4. After the huddle
Up next shows where you are. Tap the i on any step for help.

title: Match Member Tools
body: Open the Covenant Path Report in Member Tools. Add or remove names here so your lists match it.

title: Tap each name
body: Check off the steps the report shows are done. Tap Edit details to change dates.

title: Mark it done
body: When your lists match the report, tap Mark done.

title: Counsel together
body: Work through the three cards with the council. Up next shows which card is next.

title: What’s coming up
body: Add each upcoming event and its date, then tap Done. No events? Tap No upcoming events.

title: What has anyone heard?
body: Ask the council whether anyone has taken a step on the covenant path this week.

title: Questions to guide you
body: Tap How can we help? for questions from Preach My Gospel, chapter 13.

title: Check off what’s done
body: Tap a name to see its open steps and check off what the council knows. Then tap Done, or No changes this week.

title: Find your focus names
body: Under Focus names, tap Covenant Path Report or Part-Member Families to find people the ward can help this week.

title: Watch for suggested names
body: A red bar marks a suggested focus name, like a new member with only a few days left to go to the temple. Tap Add to focus names to add them.

title: Choose a next ordinance
body: Tap each focus name and choose its next ordinance. Not sure? Tap Suggested.

title: Keep these focus names
body: Review your focus names each week. Swipe a name left to remove it. When the list is right, tap Keep these focus names.

title: Brief and about people
body: Work through Return and Report, Sacrament attendance, Opportunities to invite and Focus names.

title: Who came
body: Tap everyone at the huddle. Make an extra effort to involve the youth.

title: Did it happen?
body: For each of last week’s assignments, tap Yes, Partly or No and add a short note.

title: One tap each
body: Tap each person who came to sacrament meeting.

title: Love, share, invite
body: Tap an opportunity, add an assignment and a way to invite, then who and when.

title: One assignment each
body: Tap each focus name. What will we do this week to help them toward their next ordinance? Pick an idea or type your own, then who and when.

title: Text each assignment
body: Text it to the person helping, so they know what, for whom and when.

title: Keep notes simple
body: Never add confidential information to this huddle report. Everyone who receives it can read it. Keep notes to names, ordinances and simple needs.

title: Mark each section done
body: Tap Mark done as you finish each section. Up next takes you through them in order.

title: Update the Covenant Path Report
body: Only the names that changed are listed. Update each one in Member Tools, tick Updated in the report, then tap Mark done.

title: Send the huddle report
body: Tap Send. Share it with the bishop-approved list, the stake presidency and the full-time missionaries, and include yourself. Only share via email or text message. Do not share through any other app.

title: Sent
body: Next week starts again with Before Ward Council. This week’s assignments will be waiting in Return and Report.

title: Follow up
body: As people report back, mark each assignment Yes, Partly or No, and offer help where it’s needed.

title: Help each person take their next step
body: The checklist and the huddle report show each person’s next steps. Ward council members, work with your presidencies to help. Each week at ward council, let the ward mission leader know what happened.

title: One by one
body: We are joyfully gathering Israel one by one in Christ. Every name here is someone the Lord knows and loves. Thank you for helping each one take their next step on the covenant path.
fine: Never add confidential information to this huddle report.
